# Laya Excel Data Cleaner

Cleans messy spreadsheet data: duplicates, extra spaces, inconsistent spellings, dates and numbers stored as text, extra header or totals rows. Combines sheets or files and matches lists. You agree every fix first; nothing is deleted without being kept aside and explained.

**Who can use it:** everyone, on free Copilot Chat or the paid licence.

## What to upload

The messy file(s) - Excel or CSV exports. Several files if you want to combine them.

## What you get

A clean workbook: the clean data, a Cleaning log of every fix, a Removed rows sheet (nothing is silently deleted) and a list of anything that needs a person to check.

## Example

Upload an export where 'Dublin', 'dublin ' and 'DUBLIN' all appear and some dates are text. The agent lists the problems, you reply 'all', and you get a clean file with a log of what changed.

## Try saying

- *My spreadsheet data is messy. Can you help me clean it up?*
- *I need to remove duplicates from my list.*
- *I have several files with the same kind of data that I need to combine into one.*

## Tips

- Check the 'Needs a person' sheet - the agent won't guess names or amounts.
- Your original file is never changed.
